# Pull Request Checklist

## Summary

- What is being delivered?
- Which sprint or roadmap item does this change close?

## Definition of Done

Reference: [docs/guides/definition-of-done.md](C:/estudos/StreamGate/docs/guides/definition-of-done.md)

- [ ] Scope is implemented coherently and matches the stated goal
- [ ] Documentation was updated where the change has impact
- [ ] The task used the required skills for its track from the start
- [ ] Relevant validation was executed and any environment-only failure was documented
- [ ] Relevant CI/checks are green or the exception was explicitly documented
- [ ] Contracts, OpenAPI, UI states, or shared terminology were updated when applicable
- [ ] Environment and operational impact were reviewed
- [ ] Risks, trade-offs, and remaining follow-ups were recorded

## Validation Evidence

- Commands executed:
- Tests/checks executed:
- Screens/routes/flows validated:
- Environment notes:

## Risks and Follow-ups

- Risks accepted:
- Follow-ups intentionally left for later:
